$comment: Waya legal pages reference. THIS FILE is the source of truth for the version, the date, the page URLs and the short notices pasted into other tools (GoHighLevel forms, emails, booking pages). The wording of the pages themselves is the HTML in privacy-policy/, terms-of-service/, data-handling/ and support/. scripts/check_legal.py checks the pages against this file. Change the page, then this file, then run the script. A snippet marked draft is not live anywhere until its ticket is done.
